verdict.rationale: Fellow documents its own capture of in-person meetings, but via desktop audio capture rather than a mobile app. Transcripts become searchable in the workspace, and audio uploads are supported. Missing for 10: any evidence of a mobile app for recording, mobile in-person capture flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
